items.title: The Cayley graph is the homotopy fiber of the delooped generating map
items.author: Camil Champin; Samuel Mimram; Émile Oleon
items.source_version: Author publication-page-linked conference full version arXiv2405.03264v1 (2024-05-06), native TeX with complete proof appendix, retrieved2026-10-13; own arXivv1 license CC BY4.0
items.difficulty_reason: The proof applies dependent flattening to the free-group delooping, computes transport in path spaces, and identifies the resulting total-space coequalizer with the Cayley graph HIT. This synthetic link between group relations and a homotopy fiber is non-routine; the complete flattening lemma and delooping support are retained.
